226: def _hash_asset(path, asset, synthetic, started):
227:     before_path = _checked_chain(path, directory=False)
228:     require(before_path.st_size == asset.size, "Asset size mismatch")
229:     digest, count, first = hashlib.sha256(), 0, b""
230:     with path.open("rb") as stream:
231:         opened = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
232:         require(_cross_api_identity(opened) == _cross_api_identity(before_path), "Asset changed before open")
233:         while True:
234:             _clock(started)
235:             chunk = stream.read(min(CHUNK, asset.size - count + 1))
236:             if not chunk:
237:                 break
238:             if count == 0:
239:                 first = chunk[:len(SYNTHETIC_PREFIX)]
240:             count += len(chunk)
241:             require(count <= asset.size, "Asset grew during read")
242:             digest.update(chunk)
243:         require(_identity(os.fstat(stream.fileno())) == _identity(opened), "Asset changed during read")
244:     after_path = _checked_chain(path, directory=False)
245:     require(_identity(after_path) == _identity(before_path)
246:             and _cross_api_identity(after_path) == _cross_api_identity(opened), "Asset replaced after read")
247:     require(count == asset.size and digest.hexdigest() == asset.sha256, "Asset size or SHA256 mismatch")
248:     if synthetic:

250:     _clock(started)

254: def admit_snapshot(manifest, choice, private_root, snapshot):
255:     """Admit only an explicit fixed snapshot; no cache discovery or creation."""
256:     started = time.monotonic()
257:     require(type(manifest) is TrustedManifest, "Trusted manifest object required")
258:     # Reparse bounded bytes so a manually forged dataclass is not a trust bypass.
259:     verified = load_manifest(manifest.raw, manifest.approval)
260:     require(manifest == verified, "Manifest object differs from approved bytes")
261:     require(type(choice) is str and choice in MODEL_SPECS, "Exact model choice required")
262:     model = next(model for model in verified.models if model.choice == choice)
263:     root, chosen = _plain_absolute(private_root), _plain_absolute(snapshot)
264:     synthetic = verified.approval.purpose == "synthetic"
265:     if synthetic:
266:         require(root.parent == SYNTHETIC_BASE and LABEL.fullmatch(root.name), "Synthetic root outside proposal-owned labels")
267:     # No real root can reach this point while REAL_APPROVAL is absent.
268:     require(chosen == root / choice / model.revision, "Snapshot must be the exact choice and immutable revision path")
269:     try:
270:         _checked_chain(root, directory=True)
271:         directory_before = _identity(_checked_chain(chosen, directory=True))
272:         expected = tuple(asset.name for asset in model.assets)
273:         _inventory(chosen, expected)
274:         observations = tuple(_hash_asset(chosen / asset.name, asset, synthetic, started) for asset in model.assets)
275:         _inventory(chosen, expected)
276:         require(_identity(_checked_chain(chosen, directory=True)) == directory_before, "Snapshot directory changed during admission")
277:         for observation in observations:
278:             require(_identity(_checked_chain(chosen / observation.name, directory=False)) == observation.identity, "Earlier asset changed before admission completed")
279:         _clock(started)
280:         return Admission(verified, choice, str(root), str(chosen), directory_before, observations)
281:     except (OSError, RuntimeError) as exc:
282:         raise AdmissionRefusal("Filesystem unavailable or changed") from exc
